activeSlice.scope: Repair the Hunter V2 shadow deep-analysis output contract. Provide an exact candidate-bound strict schema for the supported Groq route and explicit required-field instructions for generic JSON routes. Keep V1 authority, V2 work profile, source budgets, scoring rubric and rollout thresholds unchanged.
successCriteria: The supported Groq strict-output route requires every certified Hunter deep field and the exact requested candidate ID.
Generic JSON routes receive explicit deep-output field instructions; all outputs still pass the domain validator and candidate identity check.
No quality-delta, retrieval, failure, latency, cost, exploration or topic-share rollout threshold changes.
V1 remains production authority; no V2 persistence, canary, scheduler or production enablement.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass; rerun one 3x3 on exact merge SHA before any 30-pair gate. Stop if quality or failure remains outside policy.

priorPreGateEvidence.reason: The paced nine-pair run completed with 18 of 18 deep-analysis requests failing invalid-output. The deep output had generic JSON mode and the instruction did not enumerate required fields. Startup flags were cleared after completion.
